adjudication.rationale: Verified: `EmbedController#best` only validates `SiteSetting.embeddable_host` (and referer host) in `ensure_embeddable`, then enqueues `Jobs::RetrieveTopic` and renders `loading` when no `TopicEmbed` exists. The retrieval path (`TopicRetriever#fetch_http`) depends on `SiteSetting.embed_by_username` to find a user and `return if user.blank?`. Since `embed_by_username` defaults to `''` in `config/site_settings.yml`, the job will no-op and never create a `TopicEmbed`, so subsequent requests will keep rendering `loading` and `loading.html.erb` will reload every 30s, causing repeated enqueues. This is an infinite-loading behavior under default/misconfigured settings exposed by the diff.
